sections.content: How many people are "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers"?

159,905 people

were counted on the census as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers assemble, install, maintain and repair plumbing fixtures, heating and ventilating systems and pipes and pipeline systems. This work may be in commercial, residential and industrial premises and public buildings for non-renewable and renewable energy.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" there were more men than women (98.5% compared with 1.5%).

This means "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled construction and building trades".

Men made up 98.5% and women made up 1.5% of "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" included:

  • electricians and electrical fitters
  • glaziers, window fabricators and fitters
  • carpenters and joiners

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers", 13.2% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" was 16 to 19 years.

We can look at who worked as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

The percentage of men and women who are "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "plumbers and heating and ventilating installers and repairers", 7.3% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (85.7% compared with 14.3%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (51.4%) than an employee (48.6%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
